author: Telos I
title: AOS Update: Set Framework Integration Tasks to Active
abstract: Using update_task.py to change the status of Task 8 (Investigate Framework) and Task 9 (Design Adapter) to 'active', reflecting the current operational focus.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess

TASKS_TO_ACTIVATE = [8, 9]
UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"

print("--- Setting integration tasks to ACTIVE ---")
for task_id in TASKS_TO_ACTIVATE:
    command = ["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, str(task_id), "active"]
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        print(result.stdout.strip())
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"Error updating Task ID {task_id}:")
        print(e.stderr)
print("--- Task status updates complete. ---")
